svg.title: Interior-goal and exit-goal environments
svg.desc: Re-rendered saved validation trajectory poses, maze seed 50000. The early environment has a yellow interior-goal marker; the later environment has a daylight opening at the border. Each first-person image is paired with a reference map showing its camera pose and goal.

g.text: Two goal designs, one visual navigation task
Reach the interior cell marked in yellow.
Reach the bright opening in the outer wall.
Blue arrow: camera pose. Gold dot: goal.
Reference maps and poses are never policy inputs.
